## Before PR creation

- [ ] Only the current feature; unrelated work preserved.
- [ ] Independent review completed before this PR; findings resolved/rechecked.
- [ ] Applicable local checks passed; planned tests/workflows labeled as planned.
- [ ] Documentation synchronized; `.agent-state/` and private photos absent from staged files.

Human merge required. Feature remains incomplete until verified merged into base and its workers/state are cleaned up. PR comments require owner corrections, affected checks and independent re-review before pushing fixes; Review records reusable lessons.
